A formatter that outputs logs in a custom JSON format.

This class is used internally for testing purposes.

Initialize the formatter with specified format strings.

Initialize the formatter either with the specified format string, or a
default as described above. Allow for specialized date formatting with
the optional datefmt argument. If datefmt is omitted, you get an
ISO8601-like (or RFC 3339-like) format.

Use a style parameter of ‘%’, ‘{’ or ‘$’ to specify that you want to
use one of %-formatting,str.format()({}) formatting orstring.Templateformatting in your format string.

Changed in version 3.2:Added thestyleparameter.
